parameters.jsCode: const rows=$items('Google Sheets • Read Invoices').map(item=>item.json||{}); const partners=[{partner_id:'cabanas-armonia',aliases:['cabanas armonia','cabanas armonia y jardin de orquideas']},{partner_id:'sachatamia-lodge',aliases:['sachatamia']},{partner_id:'bellavista-cloud-forest',aliases:['bellavista lodge','bellavista cloud forest']},{partner_id:'toucan-platinum-suites',aliases:['toucan platinum']},{partner_id:'royal-river-suites',aliases:['royal river']},{partner_id:'casa-de-vista-alta',aliases:['casa de vista alta','vista alta hotel']},{partner_id:'las-terrazas-de-dana',aliases:['las terrazas de dana','terrazas de dana']},{partner_id:'terrabambu-lodge',aliases:['terrabambu']},{partner_id:'la-casa-de-cecilia',aliases:['la casa de cecilia','casa de cecilia']},{partner_id:'secret-garden-quito',aliases:['secret garden hostel']}]; const norm=value=>String(value??'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,' ').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' '); const dateOf=value=>{const text=String(value??'').trim().slice(0,10); return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(text)?text:'';}; const partySize=row=>Math.max(0,Math.round(Number(row.party_size)||0)); const today=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10); const valid=rows.filter(row=>{const date=dateOf(row.tour_date); const completed=norm(row.tour_completed)==='yes'; const cancelled=norm(row.revenue_status)==='cancelled'||norm(row.booking_status)==='cancelled'; return date&&date<=today&&completed&&!cancelled&&partySize(row)>0;}); const dayMs=86400000; const estimates=partners.map(partner=>{const matched=valid.filter(row=>partner.aliases.some(alias=>norm(row.pickup_location).includes(norm(alias)))); const groups=new Map(); for(const row of matched){const identity=norm(row.guest_email)||norm(row.guest_id)||norm(row.invoice_id)||norm(row.invoice_no)||norm(row.tour_key); if(!identity) continue; if(!groups.has(identity)) groups.set(identity,[]); groups.get(identity).push(row);} let guestCount=0; let stayCount=0; for(const group of groups.values()){group.sort((a,b)=>dateOf(a.tour_date).localeCompare(dateOf(b.tour_date))); let episode=[]; let previous=''; const finish=()=>{if(!episode.length)return; guestCount+=Math.max(...episode.map(partySize)); stayCount+=1; episode=[];}; for(const row of group){const date=dateOf(row.tour_date); if(previous&&(Date.parse(date+'T00:00:00Z')-Date.parse(previous+'T00:00:00Z'))/dayMs>14) finish(); episode.push(row); previous=date;} finish();} const dates=matched.map(row=>dateOf(row.tour_date)).filter(Boolean).sort(); return {partner_id:partner.partner_id,estimated_guest_count:guestCount,estimated_stay_count:stayCount,matched_tour_records:matched.length,last_guest_date:dates.at(-1)||''};}); const sourceDates=valid.map(row=>dateOf(row.tour_date)).filter(Boolean).sort(); return [{json:{ok:true,generated_at:new Date().toISOString(),source_last_tour_date:sourceDates.at(-1)||'',methodology:'Completed tours; pickup-location alias match; same guest and property within 14 days counted as one estimated stay.',estimates}}];
